name: Memory-Aware Reward Modeling: clear-preference pairs (de-identified release)
selection: Paper collection audit on both exports; memory-vs-no-memory comparisons with a_much/b_much labels; meta/muse-spark-1.3 excluded.
deidentification: Direct identifiers, recruitment IDs and operational metadata removed; random participant IDs; per-pair data minimisation (only the nine memories retrieved for each pair); contact details masked; quasi-identifiers replaced by typed placeholders numbered per participant ([PERSON_1], [LOCATION_1], ...); GDPR Art. 9 special-category, Art. 10 offence and third-party information removed or generalised, and pairs whose responses relied on such information withheld.
